# Mira and Julian

Mira Solen told Julian Pike that she loved him beside the harbour wall.

Julian agreed to become Mira's boyfriend that same evening.

Two years later Mira Solen and Julian Pike married in the coastal village of Northhaven Reach.

The new Solen-Pike family looked forward to a quiet and happy life by the harbour.

Nell Ostern published a shipping gazette in Cedar Quay the same week and did not attend the ceremony.

The Northhaven Council and Mayor Bramble delayed a bridge vote that same season.

A visitor named Tomas Grell asked about harbour fees and left the same afternoon.
